_about: One glossary per language: the same English interface term is translated the same way on every page, in the dictionary and in the content. Written by the content translator of the language; the dictionary translator must use it exactly.

terms.Skip silence & music: Ignorer les silences et la musique
terms.Use previous text as context: Utiliser le texte précédent comme contexte

notes: Standard French (France), understood in Canada, Belgium, Switzerland and Africa; vous; typographic apostrophe (’) and non-breaking spaces before ? ! : ; and inside « »; 'vidéo' with accent; every dropNoun reads after 'votre' (votre fichier MP3, votre enregistrement vocal).
